Integrations/Design

Frame.io V4

Frame.io V4 provides collaborative media review, project, asset, comment, sharing, metadata, and workspace management through Adobe IMS user authorization.

97 actionsSign in with Frame.io V4

Connect Frame.io V4

What your bot can do in Frame.io V4

Looks up

  • Get CollectionReturn current details for one Frame.io collection by ID.
  • Get CommentReturn one Frame.io comment by ID, optionally including its owner or replies.
  • Get Current UserReturn the Frame.io user connected through OAuth, including the user ID needed to interpret access and ownership.
  • Get Custom ActionReturn current details for one Frame.io custom action by ID.
  • Get FileReturn one Frame.io file by ID, optionally including creator, project, metadata, or media links.
  • Get File Upload StatusReturn the current completion or failure status of a Frame.io file upload.
  • Get FolderReturn one folder's current details by ID, optionally including creator, project, or metadata data.
  • Get GroupGet an account group's details without changing access.
  • Get ProjectReturn current details for one Frame.io project by ID.
  • Get ShareRetrieve a Frame.io share's current access, appearance, and review settings without changing it.
Show 31 more
  • Get Version StackRetrieve a Frame.io version stack and optionally include related data or media links without changing it.
  • Get WorkspaceReturn current details for one Frame.io workspace by ID.
  • List Account UsersList users and their roles in an account, optionally including deactivated users, without changing permissions.
  • List AccountsList Frame.io accounts available to the connected user and return account IDs for downstream discovery.
  • List Audit LogsList account audit events using Frame.io's experimental audit API, optionally expanding the acting user.
  • List CollectionsList saved collections in a project, including default review-oriented collections and their root folder IDs.
  • List CommentsList one page of comments on a file, with optional owners, replies, and a next_cursor.
  • List Custom ActionsList one page of custom actions configured in a Frame.io workspace.
  • List FilesList one page of files in a folder, with optional media links and a next_cursor.
  • List Folder ChildrenList files, folders, and version stacks directly inside a folder, with optional type filtering and media-link expansion.
  • List Folder User RolesList one page of users with direct access roles on a folder without changing access.
  • List FoldersList only the folders directly inside a Frame.io folder, one cursor-controlled page at a time.
  • List GroupsList one page of account groups and membership counts without changing access.
  • List Invited ProjectsList projects where the connected user has project-specific collaborator access but no workspace-level access.
  • List Metadata FieldsList account metadata field definitions so an agent can discover valid field IDs, types, configuration, and mutability.
  • List Project User RolesList one page of users with direct project access roles without changing access.
  • List ProjectsList a page of projects visible in a Frame.io account, including each project ID and root folder ID for asset traversal.
  • List Recently Deleted AssetsList one page of recently deleted files, folders, and version stacks in a project, ordered by the requested deletion or name sort.
  • List Share ActivitiesReturn one page of view, download, and comment activity recorded for a Frame.io share.
  • List Share AssetsReturn one page of every direct and recursively nested asset exposed by a Frame.io share.
  • List Share ReviewersReturn one page of reviewers currently associated with a Frame.io share without changing access.
  • List SharesList review shares for a project without creating or changing externally visible review links.
  • List Version Stack ChildrenReturn one page of files in a Frame.io version stack, with optional related data or media links.
  • List Version StacksReturn one page of version stacks directly contained in a Frame.io folder without changing them.
  • List WebhooksList webhook registrations in a workspace without creating callbacks or requiring external delivery infrastructure.
  • List Workspace ProjectsList one page of projects in a specific Frame.io workspace.
  • List Workspace User RolesList one page of users with workspace access roles without changing access.
  • List WorkspacesList workspaces in an account and return workspace IDs used by project, webhook, and collaboration workflows.
  • Search AccountSearch visible projects, folders, files, and version stacks across a Frame.io account by text.
  • Show MetadataReturn one Frame.io file's metadata values and definitions, optionally including fields with null values.
  • Show WebhookReturn one Frame.io webhook's current callback, event, status, and optional creator details.

Takes action

  • Add Asset to ShareAdd a file, folder, or version stack to an existing externally visible Frame.io share.
  • Add Share ReviewersGrant reviewers access to a secure Frame.io share or email recipients of a public share.
  • Bulk Update MetadataSet metadata field values across multiple files in one Frame.io project.
  • Copy FileCopy one Frame.io file to a destination folder, optionally copying metadata or comments.
  • Copy FilesCopy between one and 100 Frame.io files into one destination folder.
  • Copy FolderCopy one Frame.io folder to an optional destination folder, optionally retaining metadata values.
  • Copy FoldersCopy 1 to 100 Frame.io folders into one destination folder, optionally retaining metadata and selected comments.
  • Copy Version StackCreate a copy of a Frame.io version stack in its current or a selected destination folder.
  • Create CommentCreate a text, frame, page, drawing, or text-review comment on a Frame.io file.
  • Create Comment AttachmentCreate an attachment record and upload URLs for an existing Frame.io comment.

  • Create Custom ActionCreate a workspace custom action and return its one-time webhook validation secret with the created action.
  • Create FolderCreate a named child folder under an existing Frame.io folder and return its new ID.
  • Create GroupCreate an account group that can later receive shared resource access.
  • Create Local UploadCreate a Frame.io file record and obtain presigned URLs for uploading local file bytes.
  • Create Metadata FieldCreate an account-level Frame.io metadata field definition with type-specific configuration.
  • Create ProjectCreate a Frame.io project in a specific workspace.
  • Create Remote UploadStart an asynchronous Frame.io upload from a source URL and return its file and status links.
  • Create ShareCreate an externally accessible Frame.io review share for selected project assets.
  • Create Version StackCombine two to ten existing files in one folder into a new ordered Frame.io version stack.
  • Create WebhookRegister a Frame.io workspace webhook for selected events and return its one-time validation secret.
  • Create WorkspaceCreate a Frame.io workspace in an account.
  • Delete CommentPermanently delete a Frame.io comment by ID.
  • Delete Comment AttachmentPermanently delete one attachment from a Frame.io comment.
  • Delete Custom ActionDelete a Frame.io custom action by ID.
  • Delete FilePermanently delete a Frame.io file by ID.
  • Delete FolderDelete a Frame.io folder by ID.
  • Delete Metadata FieldDelete a mutable account-level Frame.io custom metadata field definition.
  • Delete ProjectDelete a Frame.io project by ID.
  • Delete SharePermanently delete a Frame.io review share and disable its externally visible link.
  • Delete WebhookPermanently delete a Frame.io webhook registration by ID.
  • Delete WorkspaceDelete a Frame.io workspace from its account by ID.
  • Import FileImport a file from a storage location already configured on the Frame.io account.
  • Move FileMove one Frame.io file to a folder or version stack.
  • Move FilesMove between one and 100 Frame.io files into one destination folder.
  • Move FolderMove one Frame.io folder to a destination folder and return its updated details.
  • Move FoldersMove 1 to 100 Frame.io folders into one destination folder and return their updated details.
  • Move Version StackMove a Frame.io version stack to a destination folder, changing its parent location.
  • Remove Asset From ShareRemove an asset from a Frame.io share without deleting the underlying file, folder, or version stack.
  • Remove Folder UserRemove a user's direct role from a folder, revoking that folder access.
  • Remove Project UserRemove a user's direct role from a project, revoking that project access.
  • Remove Share ReviewersRevoke selected reviewers' access to a secure Frame.io share.
  • Remove Workspace UserRemove a user's role from a workspace, revoking that workspace access.
  • Update Account User RoleChange a user's account-level access to member or admin.
  • Update CommentUpdate the text, location, annotation, timing, or completion state of a Frame.io comment.
  • Update Custom ActionUpdate the configuration or active state of a Frame.io custom action.
  • Update FileUpdate a Frame.io file's name and return its current details.
  • Update FolderRename an existing Frame.io folder and return its updated details.
  • Update Folder User RoleAdd a user to a folder with the selected role, or replace the role if access already exists.
  • Update GroupChange an account group's name and/or emoji, altering the group used to organize access.
  • Update Metadata FieldUpdate the name or type-specific configuration of a mutable account-level Frame.io metadata field definition.
  • Update ProjectUpdate a Frame.io project's name, restricted state, or status.
  • Update Project User RoleAdd a user to a project with the selected role, or replace an existing role, immediately changing project access.
  • Update ShareChange a Frame.io share's access, review, appearance, or expiration settings.
  • Update WebhookUpdate a Frame.io webhook's active state, subscribed events, name, or callback URL.
  • Update WorkspaceUpdate the name of an existing Frame.io workspace.
  • Update Workspace User RoleAdd a user to a workspace with the selected role, or replace an existing role, immediately changing workspace access.
